description:
A utility company needs regularly-spaced inspection waypoints along their line infrastructure. 

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the line layer from `/home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_lines.geojson`. This file contains 2 road/line features in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
3. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox) and search for 'Points along geometry'.
4. Open the 'Points along geometry' tool (under Vector geometry).
5. Set the Input layer to 'sample_lines'.
6. Set the Distance to **0.05** (this is in layer units, i.e., degrees). Leave 'Start offset' and 'End offset' at 0.
7. Run the tool.
8. Export the resulting 'Points' layer to a file: right-click the layer > Export > Save Features As. Choose **GeoJSON** format. Save the file to `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/inspection_points.geojson`.
9. Ensure the CRS remains EPSG:4326.
